notes.title: Live on Steam!
notes.notes:
After 1 year of solo developing this game, Forsworn is making it's initial appearance on Steam with a public Playtest demo! With the demo focused on gameplay and combat, assemble your party from 5 playable heroes and fight your way through the first Act of the game.

There's still a long road ahead but here are some priorities that are actively in development:
[list]
[*] Co-op Multiplayer
[*] Act 2 content (new enemies, new zones, new bosses)
[*] Revamping the UI
[/list]

Thank you to everyone for your support, and please leave any feedback from your playtest experience to help make this the best game possible.
